on 19 June, 2023
Author: Sarang V. Kotwal

  Mr. Yasmin E. Tavaria a/w Abhishek Yadav, Advocate for Applicants.
Ms. M. R. Tidke, App for the State/Respondent.

Ms. Nidhi Singh a/w Zoheb Khatri i/b. India Law Llp, Advocate
 for Respondent No.2.
 Coram : Sarang V. Kotwal, J.
 Date : 19th June, 2023

The Applicants are challenging the order dated
 04/07/2022 passed by the Metropolitan Magistrate, 18 th Court,
 Girgaon, Mumbai, in case No.36/SW/2020 directing issuance of
 process against the Applicants u/s 406 and 420 r/w 34 of the
Indian Penal Code.
 2. Heard Mr. Yasmin E. Tavaria, learned counsel for the
 Applicant, Ms. Nidhi Singh, learned counsel for Respondent
 No.2 and Ms. M. R. Tidke, learned App for the State.

3. Learned counsel for the Respondent No.2 is seeking
 time to file affidavit-in-reply.
 4.
The complaint filed by the Respondent No.2 mentions  that the Respondent No.2 invested about Rs.42,95,200/- in the  project developed by the accused.
The transaction was in respect  of a flat and the total consideration was fixed at Rs.82,60,000/-.
The said amount was not returned and flat was not given to the  complainant.
5. Learned counsel for the Applicant submitted that the  complaint itself mentions that the amount was given by way of  investment.
Some portion of the amount had gone to the  accused No.5 company who is represented by Respondent No.3  herein, she submitted that no document was executed in the  nature of allotment of the flat.
She further submitted that it is a  civil dispute and no criminal offence is made out.
Learned  counsel for the Respondent No.2 submitted that she has  sufficient documents and correspondence to show that the  Applicant had dishonest intention right from the inception.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the Respondent No.2 is at liberty  to file affidavit-in-reply.
It is also necessary to issue notice to the  Respondent No.3 because certain statements are made against  the Respondent No.3 as well.
Considering this, I am issuing  notice against the Respondents with the directions that the Trial  Court shall not proceed with the trial till the next date in this  Court.

7. Hence, the following order :
 ORDER (i) Issue notice to the Respondents returnable on 07/08/2023.
(ii) Till that date, the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 18th Court, Girgaon shall not proceed further in CC No.36/SW/2020.
(iii) Stand over to 07/08/2023.

(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
